    NodeInfo
    Describes a Milvus query node in a resource group, including its node ID, address and hostname.

    ResourceGroupConfig
    Describes the configuration of a resource group, including requested and limited node counts, node transfers from/to other groups, and an optional node label filter.

    Builder for ResourceGroupNodeFilter class.
    ResourceGroupTransfer
    Represents a transfer of redundant or missing nodes between resource groups, identified by the target resource group name.
